name: Punching Bag
instructions: Stand in a stable stance facing the bag with hands wrapped or gloved.
Throw straight punches from your guard, rotating your hips and shoulders.
Alternate hands and keep your chin tucked.
Work in timed rounds of 1 to 3 minutes.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: Conditioning work on a heavy bag that trains punching power and cardio.
